concepts.gloss_en: the 'speaking' (rational) being — one of the four levels domem/tzomeach/chai/medaber
wilderness / desert (as in 'and from the wilderness — a gift', Num. 21:18)

reason_for_human: The two occurrences share the consonantal form מדבר but are homographs. occ:1643 is genuinely מְדַבֵּר (the 'speaker' level, paired with חי as חַיָּה רָעָה וְלִסְטִים). occ:noid_3869's own proof text reads וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָה = 'from the wilderness a gift' (Num. 21:18) — that is מִדְבָּר, desert, a different word. Split them; only occ:1643 belongs to the 'speaking being' concept.
